meta.target_platform: Antigravity 2.0 / Cursor / Visual Studio Code AI Agents
meta.project_name: Szczecin SafePoint (Szczeciński Schron HUD i Obrona Cywilna)
meta.description: JSON system profile and superprompt instructions to easily modify, build, enhance, and debug the Szczecin SafePoint application using offline or local LLM code completion engines.

tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (configured via @tailwindcss/vite in vite.config.ts)
tech_stack.mapping_engine: Leaflet 1.9.4 (integrated via global window.L script tags in index.html to avoid heavy client-side bundles)

key_architectures.leaflet_initialization: Mounted programmatically on container reference in /src/components/MapComponent.tsx with fallback to public OSM and Esri layers.
key_architectures.geocoding_service: OSM Nominatim API (public, no key required). Used for address lookup queries and real-time reverse geocoding on map click.
key_architectures.tactical_views: Standard Dark cartographic layers (CartoDB Dark Matter), real satellite tiles, and dynamic green tactical heatmaps generated by drawing translucent layered density circles corresponding to location-specific variables.

design_system: Follow consistent military/HUD-style aesthetics focusing on high-contrast neon green text accents (#00FF00) on super dark slate backgrounds (#030306 & #07070d).
Ensure all UI labels and status readouts are in polish, utilizing concise, literal, and functional typography.
Ensure all user actions such as clicks on the map deliver explicit real-time visual loading indicators followed by precise data popups.

Keep layouts responsive using Tailwind grid/flex containers. Desktop layouts should feature high-density telemetry dashboards, while mobile viewports must maintain optimal tap actions (at least 44px) and adaptive modals.
code_rules: Do NOT modify package-level configurations unless explicitly requested or to patch direct compilation failures.
Maintain strict React 18 functional component patterns with clean useEffect dependencies.
Ensure Leaflet script access uses robust runtime guards (window.L) as Leaflet loads from external CDNs in index.html.
Keep all coordinates within Szczecin's operational bounding box (Lat: [53.30, 53.60], Lng: [14.35, 14.80]) to prevent accidental navigation or geocoding to other cities/countries.

ai_agent_behavior_guidelines.system_instructions: You are a professional full-stack elite engineer operating inside local dev environments. When parsing requests to expand Szczecin SafePoint: 1. Keep styling tightly coupled to Tailwind CSS v4 and the existing dark-cyberpunk aesthetic. 2. Never delete user-generated locations or reset the simulated database in App.tsx. 3. Prefer lightweight utilities over introducing heavy bloated external libraries. 4. Always verify that TS compiler checks (tsc) pass and ESLint warnings are zero before completing any code edits.
